slice: collector-owned edge scratch, direct trace-owner check, compact inventory and streamed metadata retirement

checks.unit: Id, Collect and ObjectModel unit suites passed; reusable context regression passed

limits: Two fresh processes per variant, serial ABBA order. Native benchmark setup/garbage creation outside timers. Real Logue functions in a drained PTY, 120 turns and one floor round trip, automatic GC enabled. CPU medians, not a general speed guarantee. No demonstrated application speedup or tail-latency reduction; ordinary timing varied about 1-3%. Collection scratch remains in the explicit Walk context; no native stack-resident edge container was introduced. Id still has an owned per-enumeration edge snapshot.
confirmation_note: A further candidate/baseline pair narrowed full-map difference to +0.95%; its explicit GC was 5.7% lower. This does not establish a general Logue speedup.
